title: Aarav's walk-in day (30s character lab)
logline: One candidate, one Saturday: call letter, one scan, one buzz, one interview, one handoff to HR.

cast.aarav: Aarav Mehta, 26, Indian man, short black hair, light stubble, navy blazer over white shirt, carries a slim black laptop bag
cast.receptionist: Sunita, 40s, Indian woman, maroon cardigan, lanyard, at a white reception desk with a phone-scanner stand
cast.panel: Neha (30s, Indian woman, glasses, grey blazer) and Vikram (40s, Indian man, beard, light-blue shirt)
cast.narrator: Fictional presenter, 30s, Indian woman, dark hair tied back, teal blazer, neutral studio background

shots.title: The call letter
shots.people: Aarav at home, early morning, looking at his phone, hopeful
shots.ui: phone: CALL LETTER · QR · Sat 14 Dec 09:00 · Tower B
shots.vo: Saturday morning. Aarav has one thing on his phone: a call letter with his own QR code.

shots.title: One scan at reception
shots.people: Aarav at a busy office reception, holds his phone out; receptionist scans it
shots.vo: At reception, one scan. No list, no queue. He's checked in, in a second.

shots.title: The buzz
shots.people: Aarav seated in a modern waiting lounge with other candidates; looks down at his phone as it buzzes
shots.ui: notification: Please proceed to Room 4 · Neha S., Vikram R.
shots.vo: He waits in the lounge. When a panel is free, his phone buzzes: room four, and who he's meeting.

shots.title: The interview
shots.people: Aarav in a glass meeting room facing a two-person panel across a table, mid-conversation
shots.vo: The panel interviews him and scores every skill. One click: select, or reject.

shots.title: Handoff to HR
shots.people: Aarav walking out of the office building into daylight, smiling, phone in hand
shots.ui: card: synced to client HR system · webhook ✓
shots.vo: Cleared. Trinexa syncs his record to the company's own H R system. Your Saturday, back.
